chars.NOUR: NOUR: a slim teenage girl wearing a bright yellow hoodie, light blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.MERYEM: MERYEM: a teenage girl wearing a pink puffer jacket, black leggings and a small white crossbody bag.
chars.DRIVER: DRIVER: a young man wearing a red tracksuit jacket with white stripes, a black cap turned backwards and a thin gold chain.
chars.STRANGER: STRANGER: a tall young man wearing a long black leather jacket, dark grey trousers and black boots, cold serious expression.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, inside a car seen from the front windshield: DRIVER at the wheel laughing and ignoring them, NOUR and MERYEM on the back seat leaning forward, worried and upset, asking to go home. Moroccan city street lights of El Jadida outside the side windows.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, inside the car: NOUR taps DRIVER's shoulder from the back seat with a pleading face, DRIVER keeps staring at the road with a cold smirk, not answering.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night, a small dark sedan driving away from the lights of a Moroccan coastal town on an empty highway, the town lights getting smaller behind it.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Very dark empty countryside road at night in Morocco, a single car with its headlights on, surrounded by black fields and no houses, ominous mood.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, back seat of a car lit only by dashboard glow: NOUR shouting a question toward the front, frightened, MERYEM holding NOUR's arm tightly, both scared.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night, a car stopped in the middle of a dark empty field in the Moroccan countryside, headlights on, dust in the beams, nobody around.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night, the STRANGER getting out of the passenger door of the stopped car and standing in the headlight beams in a dark field, looking menacing, a mysterious figure.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, through the car's rear side window: NOUR and MERYEM huddled together on the back seat in the dark, terrified, tears in their eyes.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Night, inside the car: NOUR and MERYEM angrily yelling at DRIVER, pointing at him, DRIVER turning around from the front seat with a sudden serious threatening look.
